scope: Corollary 3.9 (Motion in interval units) of the manuscript “Bounded scalar curvature and smooth extension of four-dimensional Ricci flow” (preprints/Bounded-scalar-curvature-and-smooth-extension-of-four-dimensional-Ricci-flow-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 351 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 95655c4053c94f2b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 24-25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On the intervals of Proposition 3.8, geometry at length h ≲ 1 moves negligibly over windows ∆t satisfying ϵi∆t/h → 0. Regular chart coefficients change 24 by O(ϵi∆t/h) with every fixed number of scaled derivatives. At h ≍ ai, old and new centers are O(ai) apart; at ai ≪ h ≲ 1 they are o(h) apart.
